subject.title: Google provider: implement proper Vertex AI OAuth and endpoint routing

question: Should the remaining Google Vertex work land as a dedicated google-vertex onboarding/auth path, be narrowed to runtime-only fixes already shipped, or be superseded into another canonical tracker?
rationale: Current main already ships important runtime routing and ADC pieces, but the remaining onboarding/auth evidence/default behavior changes compatibility-sensitive setup surfaces that require maintainer product acceptance.

options.title: Keep Paired With Setup PR
options.body: Leave this issue open while maintainers review the proof-sufficient onboarding/auth path in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/87800 and related Google Vertex PRs.

options.title: Close On Runtime Fix Only
options.body: Treat the shipped native transport and ADC fixes as sufficient, then leave onboarding and setup defaults to separate follow-up work.

options.title: Supersede Into Narrow Tracker
options.body: Close this issue only after choosing one canonical remaining issue or PR for the Google Vertex onboarding/auth contract.

recommendation.title: Keep Paired With Setup PR
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open while maintainers review the proof-sufficient onboarding/auth path in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/87800 and related Google Vertex PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: The open proof-sufficient PR from this owner is the clearest current vehicle for the remaining setup/auth decision.
